title: Friends
nobody_online: None of your friends are around. Suspicious.
no_friends: No friends yet. Everyone starts somewhere.
requests_intro: People who aren't your friends can send you one message. It waits here until you accept (or reply) — or decline, and they won't be told.
add_intro: Type their exact username. This server doesn't have a user directory, so you'll need to ask them for it.
add_intro_search: Type their username — suggestions show up as you type.
add_tip: Your username is {username} — hand it out to people you want to hear from.
